taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Payout beneficiary changes and confirmation-to-execution binding
controls.source_trace: Trace which beneficiary version was approved and which version the queued payout resolves, especially edits after confirmation.
controls.implementation_branch: Determine whether confirmation approves a beneficiary identity or an immutable beneficiary version. A queued payout resolving a later changed destination can violate a version-bound approval. A label change with the same account identifier is not altered routing; verify the actual sandbox destination.
controls.controlled_verification: Use a sandbox beneficiary fixture with synthetic destinations; compare approved payout with a post-approval destination change.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: An edited display label is not changed funds routing; show the effective destination used by the sandbox execution.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind payout approval to immutable beneficiary intent and retest allowed updates, cooldown and execution.
